Hi Celeste — great to hear. I've attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Silverline_MAP_v0.1.xlsx) with recommended gates, owners, and suggested dates. High level summary below:

- Kickoff / alignment meeting: Mon, 2026-12-20 (30–45m) — owners: Tessa (Redwood) / Celeste (Silverline)
- SOW signoff & procurement queue: target 2027-01-07 — owner: Celeste / Silverline procurement; Redwood point: Monica Patel
- Test environment provision & network allowlist: target 2027-01-14 — owner: Marcus Lin (Redwood infra) + Silverline NetOps
- Integration validation (end-to-end sample flows): target 2027-01-21 — owner: Jonas Weber (Redwood implementation) + Silverline integration lead
- Go-live readiness review & fallback plan: 2027-01-26 — cross-team review
- Production cutover (soft launch window): 2027-01-31

Please treat these as draft dates — I flagged tight dependencies where procurement or whitelisting sits on the critical path. Next steps I propose: 1) confirm kickoff 12/20, 2) accept the MAP spreadsheet and update owners on your side, 3) Monica and Jonas will follow up with a short sprint plan after our kickoff.

Attachments: Silverline_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — contains a lane-by-lane task list and acceptance criteria.

If 12/20 doesn't work, share two alternatives and we'll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.
